children: UK Reform Party senior aide Arron Banks said the party could form an industry union called Allied Computer & Crypto Workers Union (ACCAW) if Labour introduces a ban on overseas donations. The union would cover workers in IT, AI, and cryptocurrency, according to the report. According to Foresight News, Banks also said the party is considering another option: sending large numbers of Reform Party supporters into other unions to carry out a "reverse takeover" of existing labor organizations.

The report said crypto billionaires Ben Delo and Christopher Harborne, both long-term overseas residents, previously donated a combined 72 million pounds to Reform Party. Labour then announced plans to introduce new residency requirements and to retroactively deem the donations illegal.

title: UK Reform Party Considers Crypto Industry Union to Bypass Overseas Donation Ban
